title: Cattle alarm stays 0 while prose says the cattle already saw you
body:
On Exposed Ridge / Steading Yard opening, prose says the cattle already saw you and that cattle alarm starts at 1, but the **meter stays at 0** until a later descend/feed.

Grok-4.6 MCP wave: **14** `bugs[]` rows (S1 9 / S2 5). Players treated it as the UI lying next to the “both routes selected” yard copy.

Fix: either start the visible cattle-alarm track at the value the opening prose claims, or stop claiming the cattle already saw you / alarm 1 when the track is 0.

Evidence: grok-4.6 instant-thinking wave, 82 completed interviews, build `fe2619a8`.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 MCP wave cluster (14 mentions, 82 completed interviews).
